changes.change: When the ci block names no pubrel, pubkit sync writes pubrel's release workflow at pubrel 0.5.5, the latest release, pinned to the commit its tag names (16c6c9731b3f), instead of 0.5.2

pubkit site check, which deploy-static runs, no longer asks a page that asks not to be indexed (<meta name="robots" content="noindex">, in any case and alongside other values, or "none") for a meta description, an Open Graph card, a large twitter:card or an og:image, nor checks robots.txt for it, so a service's bare landing page (storage, maps) deploys again. Its language and title are still checked

comment: Changes not yet released. One row per change: category changed or removed (a published interface changed: major), added (a feature: minor), or fixed or security (patch). `pubrel add` appends one; `pubrel summary` sets the release's summary; `pubrel prepare` moves them into the package publet.
